findings.passage: As AG, I’m going to stand up to them. I’ve been taking on MAGA and Trump for the last seven years and I’m just getting started,
findings.note: Quoted by the Aurora Sentinel at a gun-violence panel. The story says she committed to protecting and strengthening state gun laws, named the NRA and gun lobbyists as her top priority as attorney general, and criticised the federal suit against Colorado's large-capacity magazine ban.
subjects: federal challenge to state gun laws

findings.passage: You sit down with survivors of mass shootings, and if you’re not motivated to pass gun laws after that, then there’s something wrong with you,
findings.note: Quoted by the Aurora Sentinel at the same panel. She said more must be done so people do not become survivors. The story also reports she would support legislative efforts to pass a more comprehensive assault weapon ban and said election officials should be in the business of action, not thoughts and prayers.

subjects: federal challenge to state gun laws
